projects.title: Summerville 115kV Loop: Rebuild
projects.summary: Replacing several wood pole sections on the Summerville 115 kV Loop that have reached the end of life.

places.label: Summerville
places.coordinateSource: OSM way/185236364 power=substation substation=transmission voltage=230000;115000 (unnamed); HIFLD Electric_Power_Transmission_Lines ID 113527 (230 kV) runs from this sub to OSM way/184867924 'Williams Substation'

It is the only 230/115 kV transmission substation in Summerville, and in HIFLD it has a 230 kV line to Williams plus six 115 kV lines forming a loop west through Dorchester County. The cached Dominion Summerville Loop page (desc-summerville-loop-page) says the work is on transmission lines in Dorchester County. OSM has no name tag, so the ID rests on that topology.

constructionWindows.note: Coarse budget-year window: first budgeted spending year → planned in-service date. DESC publishes yearly spending, not construction dates; spending also occurred before 2026.

caveats: Loop rebuild with one named point. Dominion's page describes about 8 miles of 115 kV structure replacement in Dorchester County. HIFLD shows the loop running from the Summerville sub (in the Berkeley County part of Summerville) through taps up to about 8 km west and southwest (for example 33.019,-80.221 and 32.987,-80.221). The work area is wider than the point.
The source gives an impossible date (04/31/26); shown at month precision.
